$comment: RTAM brand asset tree as data — the single source of truth. generate.py emits live-text source SVGs; outline.py emits *-outlined.svg distribution masters. Geometry is modelled ONCE per asset (runs + shapes, literal coords) with a list of colour-variant outputs. Bindu/positions are baked literals; derivation rules: Latin bindu cx = leading-R ink center, cy = baseline + fs*0.233, r = fs/12; Foundation wordmark descriptor x = RTAM advance-end + F6 gap 56; Devanagari forms carry NO bindu (ऋ is the self-contained vocalic-R).

assets.$comment: The city-print temple voice (stationery governance G1, ratified 2026-08-26; re-authored 2026-08-27 on founder review): Devanagari LEADS at 3x the English support line (v2.5 requires >=2x on city print). TIGHT viewBox [640,380] hugs the content (Deva adv 571.3, Latin adv 565.9 at fs32 ls4) so the img box IS the name block — no phantom padding beside the chakra on the letterhead. The support line is a LATIN FORM and therefore carries the bindu under its leading R (founder ruling 2026-08-27, per brand-book 'Latin forms carry the gold bindu'): cx = line left 37.05 + R ink-center 12.43 = 49.5, cy = 312 + 0.233*32 = 319.5, r = fs/8 = 4 — the THIRD sanctioned bindu deviation (small-size boost, favicon precedent; fs/12 = 0.3mm dust at letterhead scale). One-gold law holds via D1a: hub and bindu are the same point. Rule stays STONE (goldless lockup; the page's gold is the hub).
